desc:
🩸 REALISTIC RAGDOLLS 🩸
Every hit is real physics! Ragdolls react, stagger, clutch their wounds, limp, crawl away and bleed out 💥

 50+ WEAPONS: AK-47, AWP, Minigun, UZI, RPG, Railgun, Harpoon Gun, battlemech & more
 REAL ARMOR: Realistic ballistic helmets and vests that stop bullets... until they don't
 CARS: crash through walls, enjoy detailed crash physics, crumple them and launch ragdolls out the windshield
 RAGDOLL FIGHTS: red vs blue armies with medics, watch as ragdoll armies advance, take cover, retreat, and defeat each other.
 SCENARIOS: Home Invasion, Hostage Rescue, Apocalypse, SWAT Raid
 Many maps.
 Dynamic destruction of brick walls and glass
 Slow motion to watch every impact
 Mobile supported

🏆 Get kills to unlock new weapons!
👍 Like & ⭐ favorite for more updates!
